Function tools call the customer's server endpoint during a call with tool name and arguments; results returned to the model.

Simulations: an AI tester plays the user following a scenario and personality (e.g. impatient, confused); conversations judged against success criteria.
Docs recommend re-running simulation suites after prompt, tool or config changes to catch regressions; Evals are saved mock conversations re-run after changes.
Simulation runs take an iterations count; results show one result per simulation and iteration with passed/failed counts. No pass-rate percentage or pass^k named.
Evals offer an AI judge: a chosen LLM reads the conversation and returns pass/fail against a user-written prompt; exact and regex judges also available.
Best-practices page says to test an AI judge against responses that informed reviewers agree should pass and fail, and refine the criterion before using it as a release check.
Scorecards grade completed calls from structured outputs against conditions (0-100); docs also cover call analysis, call logs, recording and monitoring.
Warm transfer modes deliver a fixed message or a summary generated from the transcript via summaryPlan to the transfer destination.
